faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the SVNIT Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Junior Research Fellow position at SVNIT is 31st August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the JRF post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Junior Research Fellow post will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 37,000/- plus 16% HRA.

faq.question: Q3. What are the essential qualifications for the JRF role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post Graduate Degree in Mechanical Engineering or related fields, along with a B.E./B.Tech. in Mechanical, Production, Aerospace, or Metallurgy, and a valid GATE qualification.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for this position?
faq.answer: Applications should be submitted via email. Ensure all required documents are attached and the subject line clearly states the post applied for.

faq.question: Q5. Is there an application fee for the JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Junior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: The selection process will primarily involve an interview, which will be conducted in a hybrid mode.

faq.question: Q7. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is DoME/1166.

faq.question: Q8. Which department is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is being conducted by the Sardar Vallabhbhai National Institute of Technology Surat (SVNIT).

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The Junior Research Fellow position is a contract-based role.

faq.question: Q10. Where is SVNIT located?
faq.answer: Sardar Vallabhbhai National Institute of Technology (SVNIT) is located in Surat, Gujarat.
